messages.author: 2a7f346506a3e9ff
messages.subject: Memory leak in prob_agrad_ad::grad_log_prob
parts:
Hey,

Just an FYI that I've fixed a bug which manifested in memory-leak like
behaviour when exceptions were thrown. Not sure if this is relevant
elsewhere but it's worth keeping an eye out for.

Basically, memory wouldn't get recovered and the arena allocator would
continue to grow when the log_prob function throws an exception. The
fix is relatively simple: catch the exception, clear the memory and
rethrow the exception.

Also, I've added sub_row and sub_col functions which are basically
like the block() function but which return row/column vectors instead
of matrices.

Cheers,
Marcus
